test_title: PYST 01: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 06 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Change the following from active to passive:

By the time the team arrived, the technicians had already repaired the control panel and tested all functions twice.

options.text: By the time the team arrived, the control panel had already been repaired, and all functions had been tested twice by the technicians
All functions were being tested by the time the team arrived.
Everything was fixed before the team reached the site.
The technicians repaired and tested everything twice before the team arrived.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence is in the past perfect tense and describes actions completed before the team arrived.
 
• To convert it to passive voice, the focus is shifted to the objects of the active sentence: "the control panel" and "all functions."
 
• The passive construction uses the format: **"had been + past participle"** to maintain the past perfect tense.
 
• In the passive sentence, it becomes: "**The control panel had already been repaired, and all functions had been tested twice by the technicians."**

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Passive Sentence:** *"By the time the team arrived, the control panel had already been repaired, and all functions had been tested twice by the technicians."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2:** "All functions were being tested by the time the team arrived." – This sentence changes the tense to past continuous, which is incorrect in this context.
 
• **Option 3:** "Everything was fixed before the team reached the site." – This is a general statement and does not fully convey the details of the original sentence.
 
• **Option 4:** "The technicians repaired and tested everything twice before the team arrived." – This sentence is in active voice and does not fulfill the requirement to convert to passive voice.
